title: Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung (SAZV), § 6 Regelmäßige tägliche Arbeitszeit, in der vor dem 1. April 2025 geltenden Fassung (a.F.), as transcribed by buzer.de
in_force: no: the version in force until 31 March 2025, before Art. 5 No. 3 of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 (in force 1 April 2025, Art. 7(1)); it stands again only if that instruction is void
verified_how: Fetched https://www.buzer.de/gesetz/11778/al211501-0.htm (buzer's comparison page 'Änderung § 6 SAZV vom 01.04.2025', a.F. beside n.F.) on 2026-11-02 with curl and the User-Agent 'legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)', after reading https://www.buzer.de/robots.txt (it allows these paths). HTML page sha256 dac20a35300e56f56fbec9866061aeec7966584384708a04937b77a4fddb45ea. Converted by a script: the unchanged blocks and the 'Text alte Fassung' column only, in page order, one line per paragraph or list item; buzer's sentence numbers, its labels and its highlighting were dropped and its heading replaced by line 1. The Federal Law Gazette text of the 2015 Regulation (BGBl. I S. 1995) was NOT read. Checked against what the gazette does determine: Art. 5 No. 3 of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 recasts only § 6(1) sentence 3 (bgbl-2025-i-78.txt:141), and this file's sentences 1 and 2 and paragraph (2) are word for word the current text (sazv-6.txt). The old sentence 3 and its seven-item list ('insbesondere in folgenden Bereichen') rest on buzer alone: the gazette recasts the sentence without quoting it. buzer lists one earlier version of § 6, the 2015 original.
notes: An aid, not the law: buzer.de is a private consolidation. German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss. Deposited for the encoding legalese-opus-5.5 (the reading on which BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 Art. 5 No. 3 is void).
